thesaurus.definition: economically important Old World tropical cereal grass
made from juice of sweet sorghum

wiktionary.gloss: A cereal, Sorghum genus and species, the grains of which are cultivated to make flour and feed cattle. Almost all cultivated ones as well as some wild ones belong to the species Sorghum bicolor (syn. Sorghum vulgare).
Sorghum syrup.

blocks.etymology: Borrowed from French sou. Doublet of sol, sold, soldo, solid, solidus, and xu.

senses.definition: An old French copper coin worth very little.

examples.en: The beggar was happy to receive even a single sou.
examples.vi: Người ăn xin vui mừng khi nhận được dù chỉ một đồng xu.

senses.vi: đồng xu; tiền đồng Pháp xưa

senses.definition: A very small amount of money; pocket money.

examples.en: He did not have a sou left after the trip.

senses.vi: tiền lẻ; tiền tiêu vặt

thesaurus.definition: a former French coin of low denomination; often used of any small amount of money

wiktionary.gloss: An old French copper coin equal to one twentieth of a livre or twelve deniers; one sou is to the livre as one shilling is to the pound.
Cent; pocket money.

examples: I do not care a sou for your excuses.
